items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And the bizarre business of getting the Order of Lenin. Wow. We were talking just about . . .

Yes, that’s right, before that. We’ll talk about it, maybe. You coming back tomorrow? The business about LPs and how I was able to sneak jazz in, because essentially that was what happened. I was about to tell about the signing of Erroll Garner for this piano series. Erroll came into it in an odd way. He was managed, as he always was, by Martha Glaser. She saw that there was action going on with Columbia and piano. It hadn’t occurred to me to approach Erroll, because I figured he was under contract. Apropos of…
